dialogue.japanese: それでは企画開発部ゲームジャムを始めます。
dialogue.english: All right, let's begin the Game Planning & Development Club game jam.

dialogue.japanese: おなしゃす
dialogue.english: Let's do this.

dialogue.japanese: おねがいします
dialogue.english: Looking forward to working with you.

dialogue.japanese: お、おねがいします
dialogue.english: N-Nice to meet you all.

dialogue.japanese: おねがいしまぁす
dialogue.english: Looking forward to it!

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、まず自己紹介しましょうか。
dialogue.english: All right, let's start with introductions.

dialogue.japanese: 今回リーダー努めます。リーダーは初めてで少し緊張しています。よろしくお願いします。あと学部三年です。
dialogue.english: I'll be leading the team this time. It's my first time as leader, so I'm a little nervous. Nice to meet you all. Oh, and I'm a third-year student.

dialogue.japanese: 学部二年のRyutaです！趣味は鬼畜アクション制作です！よろしくお願いします！
dialogue.english: I'm Ryuta, a second-year student! I love making brutally hard action games! Nice to meet you!

dialogue.japanese: 学部三年のごっとです。Ryutaくんと同じ、プログラマーやります。ちーす。
dialogue.english: I'm Got, a third-year. I'll be programming, same as Ryuta. 'Sup.

dialogue.japanese: 学部一年のMiluです。えと、絵を描きます。お手柔らかに……
dialogue.english: I'm Milu, a first-year. Um, I'll be doing the art. Please go easy on me...

dialogue.japanese: 学部一年のかしわもちです、サウンド担当させていただきます。一生懸命頑張ります。
dialogue.english: I'm Kashiwamochi, a first-year. I'll be handling sound. I'll do my very best.

dialogue.japanese: まず、今回のゲームジャムについて軽くおさらいするね
dialogue.english: First, let's quickly go over how this game jam will work.

dialogue.japanese: 開発期間は今日一日のみ、オンラインでやっていきます
dialogue.english: We have today and today only, and we'll be working online.

dialogue.japanese: 対面じゃないの若干しんどい……
dialogue.english: Working remotely is kind of a pain...

dialogue.japanese: それは……しゃーない
dialogue.english: That... can't be helped.

dialogue.japanese: 最初に企画会議をして、そのあとは各自作業とします。
dialogue.english: We'll start with a planning meeting, then everyone will work on their own tasks.

dialogue.japanese: 実際にゲームとして遊べる状態まで持っていけるように頑張りましょう
dialogue.english: Let's do our best to get it into a genuinely playable state.

dialogue.japanese: さっそく、今回作るゲームについてなんだけど……
dialogue.english: So, about the game we're making today...

dialogue.japanese: 今回はアクションゲームにしようと思うんだけど、みんなどうかな
dialogue.english: I was thinking we'd make an action game. What do you all think?

dialogue.japanese: 急にジャンル決めちゃっていいの？
dialogue.english: Are we really deciding the genre right off the bat?

dialogue.japanese: チーム編成するときのアンケートで、アクション作りたいって声が多かったんだよ
dialogue.english: A lot of people said they wanted to make an action game in the team survey.

dialogue.japanese: 僕の専門分野キター
dialogue.english: Yes! My specialty!

dialogue.japanese: なるほどね
dialogue.english: I see.

dialogue.japanese: Miluさんとかしわもち君は大丈夫？
dialogue.english: Does that work for you, Milu and Kashiwamochi?

dialogue.japanese: 大丈夫です……多分
dialogue.english: It should... probably.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.english: Sure, that's fine.

dialogue.japanese: そしたら、具体的なところを詰めていこうか
dialogue.english: Then let's start working out the details.

dialogue.japanese: まずは世界観を全員で認識を一緒にしたいんだけど
dialogue.english: First, I want us all on the same page about the setting.

dialogue.japanese: (誰に意見を聞こうか)
dialogue.english: (Who should I ask?)

dialogue.japanese: ごっとくん何か意見ある？
dialogue.english: Got, do you have any ideas?

dialogue.japanese: え、わたし？
dialogue.english: Huh, me?

dialogue.japanese: うん、ほら、開発経験豊富だし
dialogue.english: Yeah. You know, since you have a lot of development experience.

dialogue.japanese: いや、私はいいので、下級生の意見を聞いたら？それに、私は全体の設計とか、仕様まとめる方が好きだから
dialogue.english: No, I'm good. Why not ask the younger members? Besides, I prefer overall architecture and putting specs together.

dialogue.japanese: あ、そっか
dialogue.english: Oh, right.

dialogue.japanese: Ryutaくん、何か意見ある？
dialogue.english: Ryuta, do you have any ideas?

dialogue.japanese: え？僕ですか？！
dialogue.english: Huh? Me?!

dialogue.japanese: うん、アクションゲーム専門って言ってたし、意見聞きたいなって
dialogue.english: Yeah. You said action games were your specialty, so I wanted your take.

dialogue.japanese: そうですねぇ、おやじブラザーズみたいな感じだと作りやすいですかねぇ。トラップとか作ってみたいので、洞窟みたいなのどうですか？
dialogue.english: Let's see... Something like Oyaji Brothers might be easy to make. I want to build traps, so how about a cave setting?

dialogue.japanese: なるほどね……了解
dialogue.english: I see... Got it.

dialogue.japanese: かしわもちくん、何か意見ある？
dialogue.english: Kashiwamochi, do you have any ideas?

dialogue.japanese: うーん、俺は依頼されたらそれに合わせる主義なんでぇ……
dialogue.english: Hmm... I usually just tailor my work to whatever I'm asked for...

dialogue.japanese: 曲の得意不得意とかはないの？
dialogue.english: Are there any kinds of music you're particularly good or bad at?

dialogue.japanese: あー、オーケストラとか作れたら楽しいかもです。電子音はあんまり得意じゃないですね。
dialogue.english: Oh, making something orchestral could be fun. Electronic sounds aren't really my forte.

dialogue.japanese: オーケストラかぁ……
dialogue.english: An orchestra, huh...

dialogue.japanese: Miluさん、何か意見ある？
dialogue.english: Milu, do you have any ideas?

dialogue.japanese: わ、私ですか……
うん、こんなアクションゲーム作りたい、みたいなの
dialogue.english: Yeah. Like what kind of action game you'd want to make.

dialogue.japanese: いかんせん、アクションゲームは専門外なので……
dialogue.english: Action games really aren't my area of expertise...

dialogue.japanese: そっか
dialogue.english: I see.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ今回は、一般的な横スクロールアクションゲームをベースに作っていこうと思うんだけど、どうかな
dialogue.english: Then how about we base it on a conventional side-scrolling action game?

dialogue.japanese: いいとおもいます
dialogue.english: I think that sounds good.

dialogue.japanese: そしたら、先にプログラマの二人にタスクを振ろうかな
dialogue.english: In that case, I'll assign tasks to our two programmers first.

dialogue.japanese: まってました
dialogue.english: I've been waiting for this.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあまずは役割分担なんだけど……
dialogue.english: First, we need to divide up the roles...

dialogue.japanese: Ryutaくんにシステム設計、ごっとくんはコンテンツをお願いするね
dialogue.english: Ryuta, you handle system design. Got, you take content.

dialogue.japanese: え
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: え
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: あれ、まずかった？
dialogue.english: Was that a bad call?

dialogue.japanese: いや、まずくはない、けど……
dialogue.english: No, it's not bad, but...

dialogue.japanese: 設計、できるかな……
dialogue.english: I don't know if I can handle the design...

dialogue.japanese: 多分、逆の方がいいと思う
dialogue.english: I think we'd be better off switching those around.

dialogue.japanese: そっか、ごめん……
dialogue.english: Oh. Sorry...

dialogue.japanese: ごっとくんにシステム設計、Ryutaくんはコンテンツをお願いするね
dialogue.english: Got, you handle system design. Ryuta, you take content.

dialogue.japanese: 任せてください！
dialogue.english: Leave it to me!

dialogue.japanese: 開発ルールとかも、私が全部決めちゃうってことでいいの？
dialogue.english: Am I free to decide all the development rules too?

dialogue.japanese: うん、コード書くのは二人だけだから、話し合ってやりやすいようにしてもらえればいいよ
dialogue.english: Yeah. You two are the only programmers, so talk it over and use whatever works best for you.

dialogue.japanese: ええと……なんか、要望とかあれば……
dialogue.english: Um... If you have any requests...

dialogue.japanese: 要望かぁ……
dialogue.english: Requests, huh...

dialogue.japanese: まじで何にもないし、てかよくわかんないから一任するよ
dialogue.english: I honestly don't have any, and I don't really understand this stuff, so I'll leave it all to you.

dialogue.japanese: ……そう
dialogue.english: ...Okay.

dialogue.japanese: トラップの数とかボスの種類とか、どこまで増えるか不透明だから、増やせるだけ増やせるように設計してもらえるといいな
dialogue.english: We don't know how many traps or bosses we'll end up with, so I'd like a design that can scale as much as possible.

dialogue.japanese: そんなに大規模なゲームになるの？
dialogue.english: Is this game really going to be that big?

dialogue.japanese: いや、そこまで大きくはできないけど、Ryutaくんのやる気しだいで変わるだろうから
dialogue.english: No, we can't make it that big, but it could change depending on how ambitious Ryuta gets.

dialogue.japanese: なるほどね、了解
dialogue.english: Makes sense. Got it.

dialogue.japanese: 素材の置き場だけ教えてほしいかな
dialogue.english: I just want to know where we should put the assets.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、いつも通りチャット欄に直貼りでいいよ
dialogue.english: Just paste them straight into the chat like usual.

dialogue.japanese: それだとチャット散らからない？
dialogue.english: Won't that clutter up the chat?

dialogue.japanese: あー、じゃあgolegoleクラウド使いましょう
dialogue.english: Oh, then let's use Golegole Cloud.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、サークルで使ってるやつにフォルダ作っておくね
dialogue.english: I'll make a folder in the account our club uses.

dialogue.japanese: 了解
dialogue.english: Got it.

dialogue.japanese: 逆にごっとくんがやりたいこととかある？
dialogue.english: Is there anything you want to do, Got?

dialogue.japanese: いや、特には。それよりも、ちゃんとゲームとして動くもの作りたいから。
dialogue.english: Nothing in particular. More than anything, I want to make something that actually works as a game.

dialogue.japanese: あー、そういえば、進捗報告ってどれくらいの頻度がやりやすい？
dialogue.english: Oh, right. How often would progress updates work best for you?

dialogue.japanese: それは全体に合わせるよ。
dialogue.english: I'll go with whatever works for everyone.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ……
dialogue.english: Then...

dialogue.japanese: 時間も少ないし、進捗報告いらないよね
dialogue.english: We're short on time, so we don't need progress updates, right?

dialogue.japanese: いや、それはさすがに……
dialogue.english: No, that's a little too...

dialogue.japanese: そう？
dialogue.english: You think so?

dialogue.japanese: ゲームジャムだから設計シンプルなんだよ。その分リカバリー効かないし
dialogue.english: The design is simple because it's a game jam. That also means there's no room to recover if things go wrong.

dialogue.japanese: へー、じゃあガッチガチに設計してよ
dialogue.english: Oh. Then make the design completely airtight.

dialogue.japanese: そういうことじゃないんだよなぁ……
dialogue.english: That's not quite what I meant...

dialogue.japanese: 1時間ごとに軽く報告してもらおうかな
dialogue.english: Let's do a quick update every hour.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、そのくらいならちょうどいい
dialogue.english: Yeah, that sounds about right.

dialogue.japanese: Ryutaくんとの報連相はもっと密にしてほしい
dialogue.english: I want you to check in with Ryuta more often than that.

dialogue.japanese: そのつもりではいる。グラフィッカとサウンドは任せる。
dialogue.english: That's the plan. I'll leave the artist and sound designer to you.

dialogue.japanese: 20分ごとに会議しよう
dialogue.english: Let's meet every twenty minutes.

dialogue.japanese: ……さすがに多すぎない？
dialogue.english: ...Isn't that a little too often?

dialogue.japanese: え、そうかな
dialogue.english: Huh? You think so?

dialogue.japanese: うん、普通に作業止まると思う
dialogue.english: Yeah. We'd constantly have to stop working.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、コミュニケーションは多いに越したことないじゃん？
dialogue.english: Well, you can never have too much communication, right?

dialogue.japanese: は、はぁ
dialogue.english: R-Right...

dialogue.japanese: じゃあRyutaくんだけど……
dialogue.english: Next up is Ryuta...

dialogue.japanese: 僕は何から手を付けたらいいですかね
dialogue.english: What should I start with?

dialogue.japanese: 割と自由でいいと思うんだけど、逆になにからやりたい？
dialogue.english: You have quite a bit of freedom. What do you want to start with?

dialogue.japanese: 初見殺し
dialogue.english: Gotcha traps.

dialogue.japanese: だよね
dialogue.english: I thought so.

dialogue.japanese: そしたら……
dialogue.english: In that case...

dialogue.japanese: トラップ好きなだけ作っていいよ
dialogue.english: You can make as many traps as you want.

dialogue.japanese: いいんですか？！
dialogue.english: Really?!

dialogue.japanese: ステージづくりのネタ欲しいしね
dialogue.english: We need ideas for the stage layout anyway.

dialogue.japanese: それは……
dialogue.english: Well...

dialogue.japanese: なんかまずかった……？
dialogue.english: Did I say something wrong...?

dialogue.japanese: グラフィッカ死なない？
dialogue.english: Won't that work our artist to death?

dialogue.japanese: まぁ……はい
dialogue.english: Well... yes.

dialogue.japanese: あ、たしかに……
dialogue.english: Oh, good point...

dialogue.japanese: 大丈夫です！僕が描くんで！
dialogue.english: It's fine! I'll draw them myself!

dialogue.japanese: え、あ、そう……ですか……？
dialogue.english: Huh? Oh, uh... really...?

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、まあ、うん……
dialogue.english: Then... sure, I guess...

dialogue.japanese: ステージ作りを最初にしてほしいな
dialogue.english: I'd like you to build the stage first.

dialogue.japanese: ステージですか？
dialogue.english: The stage?

dialogue.japanese: うん。グラフィッカの素材を明確にするためにも、どんなステージにしたいか考えてほしいんだ。
dialogue.english: Yeah. I want you to plan what kind of stage you want so our artist knows exactly what assets to make.

dialogue.japanese: なるほどです。了解しました！
dialogue.english: That makes sense. Got it!

dialogue.japanese: ごっとくんの指示を待っててくれるかな
dialogue.english: Could you wait for Got's instructions?

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、ごっとさんの指示があるまでは休憩ですか？
dialogue.english: So I can take a break until Got tells me what to do?

dialogue.japanese: そう、なるね
dialogue.english: I guess so, yes.

dialogue.japanese: 設計が終わらない分には何もできないからね
dialogue.english: You can't do much until the design is finished.

dialogue.japanese: 急いで終わらせます
dialogue.english: I'll finish it as quickly as I can.

dialogue.japanese: 了解しました
dialogue.english: Understood.

dialogue.japanese: あ、トラップに手を付ける前に、プレイヤーの基本操作を任せちゃってもいいかな
dialogue.english: Oh, before you start on the traps, can I put you in charge of the player's basic controls?

dialogue.japanese: わかりました！
dialogue.english: Got it!

dialogue.japanese: 歩行以外の操作はごっとくんが拡張していく感じでお願いね
dialogue.english: Got can expand the controls beyond walking later.

dialogue.japanese: 了解です
dialogue.english: Got it.

dialogue.japanese: あとは、レベルデザインだけど……
dialogue.english: Next is the level design...

dialogue.japanese: そこはRyutaくんに任せたいかな。
dialogue.english: I think I'd like to leave that to you, Ryuta.

dialogue.japanese: そうだよね、じゃあ……
dialogue.english: That makes sense. Then...

dialogue.japanese: Ryutaくんの好きな難易度で作ってみよう！
dialogue.english: Let's try making it at whatever difficulty you like, Ryuta!

dialogue.japanese: え、いいんですか！
dialogue.english: Wait, really?!

dialogue.japanese: いや……まぁ……うん……
dialogue.english: Well... um... sure...

dialogue.japanese: え？まずかった？
dialogue.english: Huh? Was that a bad idea?

dialogue.japanese: 全力出しますよ！
dialogue.english: I'll give it everything I've got!

dialogue.japanese: ……まぁ……うん
dialogue.english: ...Right... sure.

dialogue.japanese: 一旦、誰でもクリアできるくらいにしよう
dialogue.english: For now, let's make it easy enough for anyone to beat.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、その方が遊びやすいですもんね
dialogue.english: Yeah, that would make it more accessible.

dialogue.japanese: とにかく難しくしてインパクト出そう
dialogue.english: Let's make it brutally hard so it leaves an impression.

dialogue.japanese: 難しいだけだと理不尽になるかもです
dialogue.english: If it's hard just for the sake of it, it might feel unfair.

dialogue.japanese: そしたら、Ryutaくん関連でグラフィッカ先にタスク決めようか
dialogue.english: Next, let's assign the artist's tasks related to Ryuta's work.

dialogue.japanese: はい
dialogue.english: Okay.

dialogue.japanese: 今回はタイルベースで作ろうと思うんだけど、イメージできる？
dialogue.english: I'm thinking of using a tile-based system. Can you picture that?

dialogue.japanese: なんか、ブロックの組み合わせみたいな、あの感じですよね。
dialogue.english: You mean like putting different blocks together, right?

dialogue.japanese: そうそう。ハンドメイドステージだとステージ増えるごとに負担がすごいことになっちゃうからね
dialogue.english: Exactly. Hand-crafting every stage would make the workload explode every time we added one.

dialogue.japanese: わかりました。
dialogue.english: Understood.

dialogue.japanese: とりあえずステージの素材に関してなんだけど……
dialogue.english: So, about the stage assets for now...

dialogue.japanese: 大変だろうからフリー素材でいいよ
dialogue.english: It'll be a lot of work, so free assets are fine.

dialogue.japanese: え、それでいいんですか
dialogue.english: Oh, are you sure?

dialogue.japanese: うん、だってすごい量あるよ
dialogue.english: Yeah. There are going to be a ton of them.

dialogue.japanese: そう、ですか……
dialogue.english: I... see...

dialogue.japanese: 一旦後回しでいいや
dialogue.english: Let's put those off for now.

dialogue.japanese: え、いいんですか？
dialogue.english: Huh, is that okay?

dialogue.japanese: Ryutaくんの案が出ないと描くものもかけないからね。先にプレイヤーを描いてほしいんだ
dialogue.english: You can't draw anything until Ryuta has a plan. I want you to draw the player first.

dialogue.japanese: なるほど、わかりました
dialogue.english: I see. Understood.

dialogue.japanese: 仮素材だけ用意してほしいな
dialogue.english: I'd like you to prepare some placeholder assets.

dialogue.japanese: 仮ってどれくらい描けばいいですか？
dialogue.english: How detailed should the placeholders be?

dialogue.japanese: 一色で塗りつぶした四角でいいよ。サイズは64×64でお願い。
dialogue.english: A solid-colored square is fine. Make it 64 by 64 pixels.

dialogue.japanese: 今回使うタイルはこのサイズで統一になるんですか？
dialogue.english: Will all the tiles use that size?

dialogue.japanese: うん。プレイヤーのサイズもこれを基準にしてほしい。
dialogue.english: Yes. Please base the player's size on it too.

dialogue.japanese: イメージがつかめてきました。ありがとうございます
dialogue.english: I'm starting to get the picture. Thank you.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ続けてプレイヤーについてなんだけど、描きたいイメージとかある？
dialogue.english: Next, about the player character. Do you have an image you'd like to draw?

dialogue.japanese: まだ世界観が定まっていないので、想像できていないですね
dialogue.english: The setting isn't settled yet, so I can't really picture anything.

dialogue.japanese: 人と動物だったら、どっちの方が描きやすい？
dialogue.english: Which is easier for you to draw, a person or an animal?

dialogue.japanese: 圧倒的に人ですね。正直、モンスターを描けるか怪しいです。
dialogue.english: A person, definitely. Honestly, I'm not sure I can draw monsters.

dialogue.japanese: なるほどね。まぁ、モンスターに関しては後々決めようか。
dialogue.english: I see. We can decide on the monsters later.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、そうだなぁ……
dialogue.english: Let's see...

dialogue.japanese: 世界観とか無視でもいいから好きなようにプレイヤーを描いてみて
dialogue.english: Ignore the setting for now and draw the player however you like.

dialogue.japanese: え
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: ストーリーとかも決めなきゃいけなくなると思うから、Miluさんの思う主人公を描いてみてほしいんだ
dialogue.english: We'll have to decide on a story too, so I want you to draw the hero you imagine, Milu.

dialogue.japanese: キャラデザから連想してストーリーを決めるってことですか？
dialogue.english: You mean we'll build the story around the character design?

dialogue.japanese: そういうこと
dialogue.english: Exactly.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、やりたいようにやってみます
dialogue.english: Then I'll try doing it my way.

dialogue.japanese: 棒人間とかでもいいよ
dialogue.english: Even a stick figure would be fine.

dialogue.japanese: え、そんな感じでいいんですか？
dialogue.english: Really? That's all you need?

dialogue.japanese: うん。差分だって描かなきゃいけないし、大変でしょ？
dialogue.english: Yeah. You'll have to draw alternate poses too, so it'll be a lot of work, right?

dialogue.japanese: それは、そうですけど……
dialogue.english: That's true, but...

dialogue.japanese: それくらい楽な感じでいいからね
dialogue.english: You really can keep it that simple.

dialogue.japanese: は、はぁ……
dialogue.english: O-Okay...

dialogue.japanese: 差分二枚で、探検者っぽい少年、ってイメージで描けそう？
dialogue.english: Can you draw an explorer-like boy with two alternate poses?

dialogue.japanese: ……なんとなく、描けると思います。
dialogue.english: ...I think I can picture something.

dialogue.japanese: 細かいデザインは一任するけど、アドベンチャー的な世界観ならストーリーも組みやすそうだし。
dialogue.english: I'll leave the details to you, but an adventure-style setting should make the story easier to develop.

dialogue.japanese: いいと思います。了解しました。
dialogue.english: I like that. Understood.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、最後にかしわもちくん。おまたせです。
dialogue.english: Finally, Kashiwamochi. Thanks for waiting.

dialogue.japanese: はーい
dialogue.english: Okay!

dialogue.japanese: BGMと効果音をお願いしたいんだけど……
dialogue.english: I'd like you to handle the music and sound effects...

dialogue.japanese: 緊張感のあるアドベンチャーっぽい曲を作ってほしいんだ
dialogue.english: I'd like a tense, adventurous-sounding track.

dialogue.japanese: 緊張感、ですか
dialogue.english: Tense, you say?

dialogue.japanese: 音楽に詳しくないから、雰囲気でしか言えないんだけど、いけそう？
dialogue.english: I don't know much about music, so I can only describe the mood. Can you work with that?

dialogue.japanese: 世界観とかは取り込まなくていいんですか？
dialogue.english: Shouldn't it reflect the game's setting too?

dialogue.japanese: 世界観がぶれないようにするのが一番だけど、どんなステージでも汎用的に使える方がいいかなと思って
dialogue.english: Keeping the setting consistent matters most, but I thought something versatile enough for any stage would be best.

dialogue.japanese: そういうことですか。なるほど、作ってみますね。
dialogue.english: I see what you mean. All right, I'll give it a try.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、いい感じで宜しく
dialogue.english: Just... make it sound good.

dialogue.japanese: い、いい感じって、どんな……
dialogue.english: S-Sound good in what way...?

dialogue.japanese: なんか、いい感じ！
dialogue.english: You know... good!

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、はい……
dialogue.english: Well... okay...

dialogue.japanese: オーケストラとかどうかな
dialogue.english: How about an orchestral piece?

dialogue.japanese: お、いいですね
dialogue.english: Oh, that sounds great.

dialogue.japanese: 基本的にかしわもちくんのやりたいことを尊重するよ
dialogue.english: I want to respect your creative vision, Kashiwamochi.

dialogue.japanese: ありがとうございます
dialogue.english: Thank you.

dialogue.japanese: 好きにしてもらって大丈夫だからね
dialogue.english: You're free to do whatever you like.

dialogue.japanese: あとは効果音だけど
dialogue.english: Then there are the sound effects.

dialogue.japanese: 言ってもらえればいくらでも作りますよ
dialogue.english: Just tell me what you need and I'll make as many as you want.

dialogue.japanese: 本当に心強いなぁ　そしたら……
dialogue.english: That's really reassuring. In that case...

dialogue.japanese: いい感じのフリー効果音持ってきて
dialogue.english: Find us some good free sound effects.

dialogue.japanese: え
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: BGMも作って効果音も作ってだなんて大変でしょ
dialogue.english: Making both the music and the sound effects would be a lot, right?

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、それはそうですけど
dialogue.english: Well, that's true, but...

dialogue.japanese: 効果音くらい手を抜いてもらって大丈夫だから
dialogue.english: It's fine if you cut a few corners on the sound effects.

dialogue.japanese: ううん……
dialogue.english: Hmm...

dialogue.japanese: できるだけたくさん作ってほしいな
dialogue.english: I'd like you to make as many as possible.

dialogue.japanese: 了解です
dialogue.english: Got it.

dialogue.japanese: 本当に大丈夫？無理言ってない？
dialogue.english: Are you sure that's okay? I'm not asking too much?

dialogue.japanese: 全然ですよ。任せてください。
dialogue.english: Not at all. Leave it to me.

dialogue.japanese: BGMに気合入れてもらって、効果音は少しで大丈夫だよ
dialogue.english: Put your energy into the music. We only need a few sound effects.

dialogue.japanese: いいんですか？
dialogue.english: Are you sure?

dialogue.japanese: うん、使いまわせる効果音とか作ってもらえれば助かるな
dialogue.english: Yeah. A few reusable sound effects would be a big help.

dialogue.japanese: わかりました
dialogue.english: Understood.

dialogue.japanese: かしわもちくんの音楽に期待してるよ
dialogue.english: I'm looking forward to your music, Kashiwamochi.

dialogue.japanese: よし、こんな感じかな
dialogue.english: All right, I think that covers everything.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、一旦開発の全体像は見えたかな
dialogue.english: Yeah, we have a general picture of the development plan now.

dialogue.japanese: 気合い入れて開発しますよ
dialogue.english: I'm going all in on development!

dialogue.japanese: 素材できたら報告しますね
dialogue.english: I'll let you know when the assets are ready.

dialogue.japanese: 僕もそうします
dialogue.english: Me too.

dialogue.japanese: そしたら、みんな作業に移ってください
dialogue.english: Then everyone can get to work.

dialogue.japanese: 最後の実装、マージしました
dialogue.english: I've merged the final implementation.

dialogue.japanese: ありがとう。そしたらビルドするね
dialogue.english: Thanks. I'll make the build, then.

dialogue.japanese: お、ついに完成？
dialogue.english: Oh, is it finally done?

dialogue.japanese: うん。なんとか完成したよ。
dialogue.english: Yeah. We somehow finished it.

dialogue.japanese: もう一か月はタブレット見たくないかも……
dialogue.english: I don't want to look at my drawing tablet for at least a month...

dialogue.japanese: 僕は若干物足りないかも
dialogue.english: I might still be a little unsatisfied.

dialogue.japanese: そしたら、一旦テストプレイとしましょうか
dialogue.english: Then let's do a test playthrough.

dialogue.japanese: ビルドは終わってるので、いつでもどうぞ。
dialogue.english: The build is ready, so start whenever you like.

dialogue.japanese: これは……いいね
dialogue.english: This is... good.

dialogue.japanese: onedayゲームジャムにしては、いい出来だと思うな。
dialogue.english: For a one-day game jam, I think this turned out really well.

dialogue.japanese: ごっとくん、満足そうだね
dialogue.english: You look satisfied, Got.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、合格点ってところ、かな
dialogue.english: Well, I'd call it a passing grade.

dialogue.japanese: さらに上を目指す姿勢、見習わなきゃだなぁ
dialogue.english: I should learn from your drive to aim even higher.

dialogue.japanese: Miluさんとかしわもちくんは、実際遊んでみてどう？
dialogue.english: What did you think after playing it, Milu and Kashiwamochi?

dialogue.japanese: 素材足りててよかった……
dialogue.english: I'm just glad we had enough assets...

dialogue.japanese: あ、そっちの感想？
dialogue.english: Oh, that's your takeaway?

dialogue.japanese: 効果音の実装完璧じゃないですか
dialogue.english: The sound effects were implemented perfectly!

dialogue.japanese: イメージ通りに実装できてよかったぁ
dialogue.english: I'm so glad they came out the way I imagined.

dialogue.japanese: と、まぁこんな感じ、かな
dialogue.english: And... I guess that's that.

dialogue.japanese: え？
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: え？って何？
dialogue.english: What do you mean, “huh?”

dialogue.japanese: これで終わりなわけないでしょ？
dialogue.english: You don't think we're stopping here, do you?

dialogue.japanese: え？
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: 一日で終わらせたらもったいないじゃないですか
dialogue.english: It'd be a waste to end it after just one day.

dialogue.japanese: ……ってことは
dialogue.english: ...You mean...?

dialogue.japanese: 継続開発らしいですよ
dialogue.english: Looks like we're continuing development.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、頑張りましょうよ！
dialogue.english: Come on, let's keep at it!

dialogue.japanese: は、はは……
dialogue.english: H-Haha...

dialogue.japanese: ……完成、かな？
dialogue.english: ...Is it finished?

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、動きますね。
dialogue.english: Well, it runs.

dialogue.japanese: 素材も、一応全部あります。
dialogue.english: Technically, all the assets are there.

dialogue.japanese: 曲も流れてますねぇ。
dialogue.english: The music plays too.

dialogue.japanese: なんか……ゲームっぽくはなったね。
dialogue.english: It... kind of looks like a game now.

dialogue.japanese: でも、このゲームって結局何が面白いの？
dialogue.english: But what exactly is supposed to be fun about it?

dialogue.japanese: 途中から誰も何も決めなくなっちゃいましたもんね。
dialogue.english: At some point, everyone just stopped making decisions.

dialogue.japanese: 私は言われたものを描いただけですし……
dialogue.english: I only drew what I was told to draw...

dialogue.japanese: 僕も依頼通り作っただけですね。
dialogue.english: And I only made what I was asked to make.

dialogue.japanese: 誰も間違ってはいない。
dialogue.english: Nobody did anything wrong.

dialogue.japanese: 誰もゲームを作ってなかった。
dialogue.english: But nobody was actually making a game.

dialogue.japanese: ……ごめん。
dialogue.english: ...I'm sorry.

dialogue.japanese: クリアできます。
dialogue.english: It can be beaten.

dialogue.japanese: 素材も全部あります。
dialogue.english: All the assets are there.

dialogue.japanese: 音も鳴ります。
dialogue.english: The sound works.

dialogue.japanese: バグもありません。
dialogue.english: There are no bugs.

dialogue.japanese: ……なんか、面白くないね。
dialogue.english: ...But somehow, it isn't fun.

dialogue.japanese: "完成"と"面白い"は違うから。
dialogue.english: “Finished” and “fun” are not the same thing.

dialogue.japanese: そうだね……
dialogue.english: You're right...

dialogue.japanese: マップジェネレーター完成。
dialogue.english: Map generator complete.

dialogue.japanese: システムも全部作り直した。
dialogue.english: I rebuilt the entire system too.

dialogue.japanese: ステージ作る必要もうないんですか？
dialogue.english: So I don't need to make stages anymore?

dialogue.japanese: え……全部描き直しですか？
dialogue.english: What...? Do I have to redraw everything?

dialogue.japanese: 曲もステージごとに全部変えるんです？
dialogue.english: Do I have to make different music for every stage too?

dialogue.japanese: ちょ、ちょっと待って！
dialogue.english: W-Wait a second!

dialogue.japanese: ステージ自分で作っても...
dialogue.english: I can make the stages myself...

dialogue.japanese: いや、その前に設計変更する。
dialogue.english: No. First, I'm changing the design.

dialogue.japanese: えぇ...
dialogue.english: What...?

dialogue.japanese: 終わらない……
dialogue.english: We're never going to finish...

dialogue.japanese: 終わらないですねぇ……
dialogue.english: No, we're not going to finish...

dialogue.japanese: …………ごめん、時間切れ。
dialogue.english: ...Sorry. We're out of time.

dialogue.japanese: ……やりすぎたね。
dialogue.english: ...We went too far.

dialogue.japanese: どう？
dialogue.english: Well?

dialogue.japanese: 面白くないね。
dialogue.english: It's not fun.

dialogue.japanese: ……はい。
dialogue.english: ...Yeah.

dialogue.japanese: 曲だけ浮いてる気がします。
dialogue.english: The music feels completely out of place.

dialogue.japanese: 消す？
dialogue.english: Delete it?

dialogue.japanese: 消そうか。
dialogue.english: Let's delete it.

dialogue.japanese: あ。
dialogue.english: Oh.

dialogue.japanese: あれ。
dialogue.english: Wait.

dialogue.japanese: リスタートしてもすぐやられるんだけど。
dialogue.english: I die again the instant I restart.

dialogue.japanese: あー。
dialogue.english: Ah.

dialogue.japanese: 詰みだね。
dialogue.english: It's a softlock.

dialogue.japanese: 針の上でセーブされちゃいましたね……
dialogue.english: It saved right on top of the spikes...

dialogue.japanese: 永遠に死に続けるホラーゲームになりましたね。
dialogue.english: We accidentally made a horror game where you die forever.

dialogue.japanese: 想定できなかった……
dialogue.english: I didn't see that coming...

dialogue.japanese: ……これは監督者責任のわたしのせいだ
dialogue.english: ...This is my fault as the person in charge.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、はは……
dialogue.english: Well... haha...

dialogue.japanese: もっと追加しましょう！
dialogue.english: Let's add more!

dialogue.japanese: じゃあキャラも増やします！
dialogue.english: Then I'll add more characters!

dialogue.japanese: 曲もあと三曲作ります！
dialogue.english: I'll make three more tracks!

dialogue.japanese: いいね！！
dialogue.english: Sounds great!!

dialogue.japanese: もういっそ仕様変えます！
dialogue.english: Let's just change the whole spec!

dialogue.japanese: え？
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: さっき決めたのやめます！もはやこれはゲームではない！芸術だ！
dialogue.english: Forget what we just decided! This is no longer a game! It's art!

dialogue.japanese: それはさすがに……
dialogue.english: That's going a little too far...

dialogue.japanese: ありです！
dialogue.english: I'm in!

dialogue.japanese: やりましょう！
dialogue.english: Let's do it!

dialogue.japanese: え、ごっとくん……
dialogue.english: Wait, Got...?

dialogue.japanese: うん、手遅れ
dialogue.english: Yep. It's too late.

dialogue.japanese: ……完璧
dialogue.english: ...Perfect.

dialogue.japanese: バグなし！
dialogue.english: No bugs!

dialogue.japanese: 素材全部間に合いました
dialogue.english: We finished all the assets in time.

dialogue.japanese: BGMも効果音も実装確認済みです。
dialogue.english: The music and sound effects are all implemented and checked.

dialogue.japanese: 細かいとこまでみてくれてありがとうございます！
dialogue.english: Thank you for checking every last detail!

dialogue.japanese: 最後まで遊んでもらえた……
dialogue.english: They played all the way to the end...

dialogue.japanese: 全部見てもらえて嬉しいですね。
dialogue.english: I'm glad they got to see everything.

dialogue.japanese: このゲーム、ちゃんと最後まで面白かった。
dialogue.english: This game was genuinely fun from beginning to end.

dialogue.japanese: みんな、本当にありがとう。
dialogue.english: Thank you so much, everyone.

dialogue.japanese: 楽しかったです！
dialogue.english: I had a great time!

dialogue.japanese: ゲームジャムってこんなに面白いんですね。
dialogue.english: I never knew game jams could be this much fun.

dialogue.japanese: またやりたいです。
dialogue.english: I'd love to do this again.

dialogue.japanese: ……まぁ。
dialogue.english: ...Yeah.

dialogue.japanese: 次はもっと面白いもの作ろう。
dialogue.english: Next time, let's make something even better.
...Of course!

dialogue.japanese: クリア！
dialogue.english: Clear!

dialogue.japanese: え
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: え
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: え
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: ノーセーブクリア？
dialogue.english: A no-save clear?

dialogue.japanese: それでこそ開発者。
dialogue.english: Now that's a developer.

dialogue.japanese: だめだこりゃ
dialogue.english: This is hopeless.

dialogue.japanese: ここまで全部見たんだね。
dialogue.english: You've seen everything there is to see.

dialogue.japanese: ありがとう。
dialogue.english: Thank you.

dialogue.japanese: 君は知っているかもしれないけど、
dialogue.english: You may already know this, but...

dialogue.japanese: 開発には正解なんてない。
dialogue.english: There is no single right answer in game development.

dialogue.japanese: 誰が悪いわけでもない。
dialogue.english: No one person is to blame.

dialogue.japanese: 指示に最適解もない。
dialogue.english: There is no perfect way to give directions.

dialogue.japanese: 実装方法の
dialogue.english: When it comes to implementation...

dialogue.japanese: 世界観の
dialogue.english: ...or worldbuilding...

dialogue.japanese: 答えはひとつじゃない。
dialogue.english: ...there is more than one answer.

dialogue.japanese: それに
dialogue.english: And...

dialogue.japanese: 正しさを持つのは、
dialogue.english: the right answer...

dialogue.japanese: 君だけじゃない。
dialogue.english: doesn't belong to you alone.

dialogue.japanese: これ以上は語らなくてもいいかな。
dialogue.english: I think that's all I need to say.

dialogue.japanese: ここまで遊んでくれた君なら、
dialogue.english: If you've played this far...

dialogue.japanese: きっと良い企画開発者になれる。
dialogue.english: I'm sure you'll become a great game planner.

dialogue.japanese: 最後に、
dialogue.english: And finally...

dialogue.japanese: ここまで遊んでくれてありがとう。
dialogue.english: Thank you for playing all the way to the end.

dialogue.japanese: Thank you for Playing
dialogue.english: Thank you for playing.

dialogue.japanese:
せっかくだし、コンテストとかを見越した
すごいの作りたいんだけど、どう？
dialogue.english:
Since we have the chance, I'd like to make something incredible that we could enter in a contest.
What do you think?

dialogue.japanese:
アバウトなうえに無茶言うじゃん……
まぁ、やるならやるで全然コード書くけど……
dialogue.english:
That's vague and asking a lot...
But if we're doing it, I'll write the code...

dialogue.japanese: 他のみんなはどう思う？
dialogue.english: What does everyone else think?

dialogue.japanese:
全然ありだと思います！
即死トラップ満載の詰みアクションゲーとか作りたいな
dialogue.english:
I'm totally on board!
I'd love to make a near-impossible action game packed with instant-death traps.

dialogue.japanese:
演出凝ってみたいな……
アニメーションとかエフェクトいっぱいにして……
dialogue.english:
I'd love to go all out on the presentation...
With lots of animations and effects...

dialogue.japanese:
音重ねまくって、
深みのあるオーケストラとか作ってみたいかも
dialogue.english: I might like to layer lots of sounds into a rich orchestral piece.

dialogue.japanese: 自分は特に希望ないから、皆に任せるよ
dialogue.english: I don't have any particular preference, so I'll leave it to everyone else.

dialogue.japanese: えぇと……俺もサウンドだし、他の人に合わせますよ
dialogue.english: Um... I'm just doing sound, so I'll go along with what everyone else wants.

dialogue.japanese: グラフィッカからも、特に希望はないです……
dialogue.english: The artist has no particular requests either...

dialogue.japanese: プログラマ二人はどう思う？
dialogue.english: What do our two programmers think?

dialogue.japanese:
皆が何でもいいって言うなら
僕アクション作りたいです！
dialogue.english:
If nobody else minds,
I want to make an action game!

dialogue.japanese:
まぁ、Ryuta君がこう言ってるから……
アクションでいいんじゃない？
dialogue.english:
Well, since Ryuta feels that strongly...
an action game sounds fine, doesn't it?

dialogue.japanese:
アクションかシューティングを作りたいなって思うんだけど
みんなはどう思う？
dialogue.english:
I'm thinking of making an action game or a shooter.
What do you all think?

dialogue.japanese:
え、めっちゃいいじゃないですか
僕アクション作るの得意ですよ！
dialogue.english:
That sounds awesome!
I'm great at making action games!

dialogue.japanese: 他のみんなはどう思う？
dialogue.english: What does everyone else think?

dialogue.japanese:
無難なシステムなら実装も難しくないだろうし、
いいんじゃない？
dialogue.english:
A straightforward system shouldn't be hard to implement,
so why not?

dialogue.japanese:
えと……メカっぽいの描くの苦手なんですけど……
それで大丈夫なら、いいと思います
dialogue.english:
Um... I'm not good at drawing mechanical things...
If that's okay, then I think it sounds good.

dialogue.japanese:
まぁ、いいと思います
曲の雰囲気とか言ってもらえれば、全然作るので
dialogue.english:
Sure, I think it's fine.
Just tell me what mood you want for the music and I can make it.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、アクションゲームを作る方向で
dialogue.english: Then we'll go with an action game.

dialogue.japanese: 次に、みんなにタスクを振っていこうと思うんだけど...
dialogue.english: Next, I'm going to assign everyone their tasks...

dialogue.japanese: まずはごっと
dialogue.english: Let's start with Got.

dialogue.japanese: あ、私からですか
dialogue.english: Oh, me first?

dialogue.japanese: 設計はごっとに任せたいからね
dialogue.english: I want to put you in charge of the design, Got.

dialogue.japanese: あぁ、そうですか
dialogue.english: Oh. All right.

dialogue.japanese: それじゃあ...(どんなタスクを振ろうかな)
dialogue.english: Then... (What task should I give him?)

dialogue.japanese: 全体の設計を作って僕に先に見せてほしいな
dialogue.english: I'd like you to design the overall structure and show it to me first.

dialogue.japanese: とりあえず、”プレイヤー操作・罠・ステージ１つ”くらいの規模で
dialogue.english: For now, keep the scope to something like “player controls, traps, and one stage.”

dialogue.japanese: なるほど、スコープは小さめですね
dialogue.english: I see. A fairly small scope.

dialogue.japanese: うん、あとでみんなが見れるようにドキュメントもまとめてほしい
dialogue.english: Yeah, and I'd like you to write it up so everyone can refer to it later.

dialogue.japanese:
了解です。
じゃあ、全体の構造だけ先に決めて、細かいところはあとで詰めます
dialogue.english:
Understood.
I'll decide the overall structure first and work out the details later.

dialogue.japanese:
本当に大まかでいいからね？！
ごっどにお願いするといつも細部までこだわりつくしちゃうから......
dialogue.english:
A very rough outline is enough, okay?!
Whenever I ask you, Got, you always obsess over every last detail...

dialogue.japanese: まぁ.......とりあえず、動かせる程度までは作っておきます
dialogue.english: Well... I'll at least get it to a runnable state for now.

dialogue.japanese: 優秀だなぁ......
dialogue.english: You're seriously good at this...

dialogue.japanese: 明日までに簡単にまとめてきてほしいんだ。
dialogue.english: I'd like you to put together a quick summary by tomorrow.
...Tomorrow?

dialogue.japanese:
うん、雑でいいよ。
設計なんて開発が進につ入れて確立していくでしょ。
dialogue.english:
Yeah, it can be rough.
The design will take shape as development progresses, right?
Huh? But... fine, I guess...

dialogue.japanese: とりあえずたたき台みたいな感じだから、よろしく
dialogue.english: It's just a starting point for now, so I'm counting on you.

dialogue.japanese: 僕は設計よくわかんないから、とりあえず全部よろしく
dialogue.english: I don't really understand design, so just handle everything for now.

dialogue.japanese: ......全部、ですか
dialogue.english: ...Everything?

dialogue.japanese: うん、好きにやっていいよ
dialogue.english: Yeah. Do whatever you like.
Uh... right... okay...

dialogue.japanese: それでは、春みんげ～第一回オンラインミーティングを始めます
dialogue.english: All right, let's begin Spring Minge's first online meeting.

dialogue.japanese: おなしゃす
dialogue.english: Let's do this.

dialogue.japanese: お願いします
dialogue.english: Looking forward to working with you.

dialogue.japanese: お、おねがいします
dialogue.english: N-Nice to meet you all.

dialogue.japanese: おねがいしまぁす
dialogue.english: Looking forward to it!

dialogue.japanese: じゃあ、まず自己紹介しましょうか
dialogue.english: All right, let's start with introductions.

dialogue.japanese:
今回リーダーを務めます。学部三年の[name]です
リーダーは初めてで少し緊張していますが、宜しくお願いします
dialogue.english:
I'll be leading the team this time. I'm [name], a third-year student.
It's my first time as leader, so I'm a little nervous, but I look forward to working with you all.

dialogue.japanese:
学部二年のRyutaです
あ、プログラマです。好きなゲームはトラップマンです
dialogue.english:
I'm Ryuta, a second-year student.
Oh, and I'm a programmer. My favorite game is Trap Man.

dialogue.japanese:
学部三年のごっとです
プログラマで、Ryutaくんのサポートやります
dialogue.english:
I'm Got, a third-year student.
I'm a programmer, and I'll be supporting Ryuta.

dialogue.japanese:
が、学部一年のMiluです
えと、グラフィッカでが、がんばります！
dialogue.english:
I-I'm Milu, a first-year student.
Um, I'm the artist, and I'll d-do my best!

dialogue.japanese:
学部二年のかしわもちです
えーと、サウンドやります。　はーい
dialogue.english:
I'm Kashiwamochi, a second-year student.
Uh, I'll be doing sound. Yep.

dialogue.japanese: 今後の予定だけど
dialogue.english: About the schedule going forward...

dialogue.japanese: 今回は、全体ミーティングをもとに
dialogue.english: Based on today's full-team meeting,

dialogue.japanese: 作業は各々進めてください
dialogue.english: please proceed with your individual tasks.

dialogue.japanese: 今回はオフラインで集まりはしないんだね
dialogue.english: So we won't be meeting in person this time?

dialogue.japanese: うん、大学の立ち入り禁止期間とかぶちゃっててね
dialogue.english: Right. It overlaps with the period when campus is closed.

dialogue.japanese: あぁ、入試ですか……
dialogue.english: Oh, because of the entrance exams...

dialogue.japanese: あと卒業式もあるからね
dialogue.english: And there's the graduation ceremony too.

dialogue.japanese: 俺は実家変えるから、オンラインしか難しいね
dialogue.english: I'm moving back home, so online is my only real option.

dialogue.japanese: そういうわけで、オンラインで進めていきます
dialogue.english: For those reasons, we'll be working online.

dialogue.japanese: テストプレイ会を目標に頑張りましょう
dialogue.english: Let's work toward having it ready for the playtesting event.

dialogue.japanese: というわけで、とりあえず今回作るゲームの大まかな方向性を決めていきたいと思います
dialogue.english: So, first I'd like us to decide the general direction for the game we're making.

dialogue.japanese: ええと...(なんて声をかけよう)
dialogue.english: Um... (How should I bring this up?)

dialogue.japanese: おなかすいたー
dialogue.english: I'm hungry!

dialogue.japanese: (おなかが鳴る)
dialogue.english: (stomach growls)

dialogue.japanese: おすしたべたい
dialogue.english: I want sushi.

dialogue.japanese: おっすおっす。今ちょっといいすか？
dialogue.english: Yo, yo. Got a minute?

dialogue.japanese: 大丈夫です。どうしました？
dialogue.english: Sure. What's up?

dialogue.japanese: お前ら今、ゲーム作ってるらしいじゃん？
dialogue.english: I hear you guys are making a game right now.

dialogue.japanese: はい。ゲームジャムで作ってますけど
dialogue.english: Yeah, for a game jam.

dialogue.japanese: じゃあさ、そのゲームに俺を出してくれよ～。頼むよ～
dialogue.english: Then put me in the game! Come on, I'm begging you!

dialogue.japanese: 急に何を言い出すんですか
dialogue.english: Where did that come from?

dialogue.japanese: いいじゃんいいじゃん。隠しキャラとかでさ。俺そういうの好きだから
dialogue.english: Come on, it'd be great! Make me a secret character or something. I love that stuff.

dialogue.japanese: だいっちゃん先輩を出す理由がないんですけど
dialogue.english: We have no reason to put you in the game, Daittyan.

dialogue.japanese: 理由？　俺が出たいから。はい論破
dialogue.english: A reason? Because I want to be in it. Checkmate.

dialogue.japanese: 論破できてないですよ
dialogue.english: That doesn't prove anything.

dialogue.japanese: ファッ！？　じゃあ敵キャラでもいいゾ。倒されたら『やりますねぇ！』って言うから
dialogue.english: What?! Fine, an enemy works too. When you beat me, I'll say, “Not bad!”

dialogue.japanese: それ、倒された側の台詞じゃないですよね
dialogue.english: That's not something the one who lost would say.

dialogue.japanese: 細かいこと気にするとハゲるゾ。俺はもうキャラ設定まで考えてるから
dialogue.english: Sweat the small stuff and you'll go bald, man. I've already figured out my character concept.

dialogue.japanese: 聞いてないですけど、一応聞きます
dialogue.english: I didn't ask, but let's hear it.

dialogue.japanese: 最強の助っ人キャラ。攻撃力カンスト、体力無限、俺が来た瞬間ゲームクリア
dialogue.english: The ultimate helper character. Maxed-out attack, infinite health, and the moment I show up, you win.

dialogue.japanese: ゲームを壊しに来てるじゃないですか
dialogue.english: You'd completely break the game!

dialogue.japanese: 最強キャラはロマンだろ？　当たり前だよなぁ？
dialogue.english: Overpowered characters are the dream, right? Obviously!

dialogue.japanese: せめて背景のポスターくらいなら考えます
dialogue.english: I might consider putting you on a poster in the background.

dialogue.japanese: マジ？　やったぜ。じゃあ写真送るわ。盛れてるやつ厳選するから見とけよ見とけよ～
dialogue.english: Seriously? Yes! I'll send you a photo. I'll pick the most flattering one, so just you wait!

dialogue.japanese: 別に実写で出すとは言ってないです
dialogue.english: I never said we'd use an actual photo of you.

dialogue.japanese: えぇ……。まあ多少はね？　採用されたら教えてくれよな～頼むよ～
dialogue.english: Come on... Give a guy a break. Let me know if I make the cut, okay? I'm counting on you!

dialogue.japanese: はいはい。余裕があったら入れておきます
dialogue.english: Sure, sure. I'll add you if we have time.

dialogue.japanese: javaの過去問ある？
dialogue.english: Do you have any old Java exams?

dialogue.japanese: ない
dialogue.english: Nope.

dialogue.japanese: まじか
dialogue.english: Seriously?

dialogue.japanese: Ex8解けた？
dialogue.english: Did you solve Ex8?

dialogue.japanese: 答えほしいの？
dialogue.english: Do you want the answer?

dialogue.japanese: ください
dialogue.english: Please.

dialogue.japanese: はい
dialogue.english: Here you go.

dialogue.japanese: 間違ってることはないと思うけど
dialogue.english: I don't think it's wrong, at least.

dialogue.japanese: なんか違うファイル混じってない？
dialogue.english: Isn't there some unrelated file mixed in here?

dialogue.japanese: あ
dialogue.english: Oh.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、きにしないで
dialogue.english: Well, don't worry about it.

dialogue.japanese: 気になるんだが
dialogue.english: Now I'm curious.

dialogue.japanese: 見られて困らないからいいよ
dialogue.english: There's nothing in there I mind you seeing, so it's fine.

dialogue.japanese: いいんかい
dialogue.english: You're really okay with that?

dialogue.japanese: ちなみにこのファイル何
dialogue.english: By the way, what is this file?

dialogue.japanese: ゲーム開発の時の設計のテンプレ。開発ルールのReadmeとか入ってる。なんでここにあるんだろ
dialogue.english: A design template for game development. It has a README with development rules and stuff. I wonder why it's in there.

dialogue.japanese: 知らん
dialogue.english: Beats me.

dialogue.japanese: かしわもちくん
dialogue.english: Kashiwamochi.

dialogue.japanese: 今度の南方同人イベントに出展するんだって？
dialogue.english: I heard you're exhibiting at the upcoming Nanpo indie event.

dialogue.japanese: そうですよ。興味ありますか？
dialogue.english: That's right. Are you interested?

dialogue.japanese: CD一枚買わせてください
dialogue.english: Let me buy one of your CDs.

dialogue.japanese: 毎度ありです
dialogue.english: Thank you for your business.

dialogue.japanese: 和風オーケストラ、やっぱり良い
dialogue.english: Japanese-style orchestral music really is great.

dialogue.japanese: 得意分野です
dialogue.english: It's my specialty.

dialogue.japanese: (画像と共に)これMiluさんの？
dialogue.english: (with an image) Is this yours, Milu?

dialogue.japanese: です。部室にありましたか？
dialogue.english: It is. Was it in the clubroom?

dialogue.japanese: うん。もう家帰ったよね？部室に置きっぱなしでもいい？
dialogue.english: Yeah. You've already gone home, right? Is it okay if I leave it in the clubroom?

dialogue.japanese: 本棚に隠しておいてもらえると助かります
dialogue.english: It would help if you could hide it on the bookshelf.

dialogue.japanese: 隠す？
dialogue.english: Hide it?

dialogue.japanese: あまり見られたくないので
dialogue.english: I don't really want anyone to see it.

dialogue.japanese: 了解。グラフィッカの棚に入れとくね
dialogue.english: Got it. I'll put it on the art team's shelf.

dialogue.japanese: ありがとうございます
dialogue.english: Thank you.

dialogue.japanese: ヌプラチューンやるんですけどどうですか？！
dialogue.english: We're playing Nupratune. Want to join?!

dialogue.japanese: ヌプラ！いいですねぇ
dialogue.english: Nupra! Sounds good!

dialogue.japanese: 明日の夜９時からです！
dialogue.english: Tomorrow night at nine!

dialogue.japanese: りょ
dialogue.english: Gotcha.

dialogue.japanese: あと、今度協力型アクションゲームのH.E.P.O.の大型アプデあるんですけど、やりませんか？
dialogue.english: Also, the co-op action game H.E.P.O. has a major update coming. Want to play?

dialogue.japanese: へぽ？初めて聞く
dialogue.english: H.E.P.O.? Never heard of it.

dialogue.japanese: めっちゃおもろいです
dialogue.english: It's seriously fun.

dialogue.japanese: アクション好きのRyutaくんが言うなら間違いないな
dialogue.english: If an action-game fan like you recommends it, it must be good.

dialogue.japanese: おすすめです！
dialogue.english: I highly recommend it!

dialogue.japanese: 買った
dialogue.english: Bought it.

dialogue.japanese: かっけぇっす！
dialogue.english: You're a legend!

dialogue.japanese: これは……いいね
dialogue.english: This is... good.

dialogue.japanese: onedayゲームジャムにしては、いい出来だと思うな。
dialogue.english: For a one-day game jam, I think this turned out really well.

dialogue.japanese: ごっとくん、満足そうだね
dialogue.english: You look satisfied, Got.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、合格点ってところ、かな
dialogue.english: Well, I'd call it a passing grade.

dialogue.japanese: さらに上を目指す姿勢、見習わなきゃだなぁ
dialogue.english: I should learn from your drive to aim even higher.

dialogue.japanese: Miluさんとかしわもちくんは、実際遊んでみてどう？
dialogue.english: What did you think after playing it, Milu and Kashiwamochi?

dialogue.japanese: 素材足りててよかった……
dialogue.english: I'm just glad we had enough assets...

dialogue.japanese: あ、そっちの感想？
dialogue.english: Oh, that's your takeaway?

dialogue.japanese: 効果音の実装完璧じゃないですか
dialogue.english: The sound effects were implemented perfectly!

dialogue.japanese: イメージ通りに実装できてよかったぁ
dialogue.english: I'm so glad they came out the way I imagined.

dialogue.japanese: と、まぁこんな感じ、かな
dialogue.english: And... I guess that's that.

dialogue.japanese: え？
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: え？って何？
dialogue.english: What do you mean, “huh?”

dialogue.japanese: これで終わりなわけないでしょ？
dialogue.english: You don't think we're stopping here, do you?

dialogue.japanese: え？
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: 一日で終わらせたらもったいないじゃないですか
dialogue.english: It'd be a waste to end it after just one day.

dialogue.japanese: ……ってことは
dialogue.english: ...You mean...?

dialogue.japanese: 継続開発らしいですよ
dialogue.english: Looks like we're continuing development.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、頑張りましょうよ！
dialogue.english: Come on, let's keep at it!

dialogue.japanese: は、はは……
dialogue.english: H-Haha...

dialogue.japanese: ……完成、かな？
dialogue.english: ...Is it finished?

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、動きますね。
dialogue.english: Well, it runs.

dialogue.japanese: 素材も、一応全部あります。
dialogue.english: Technically, all the assets are there.

dialogue.japanese: 曲も流れてますねぇ。
dialogue.english: The music plays too.

dialogue.japanese: なんか……ゲームっぽくはなったね。
dialogue.english: It... kind of looks like a game now.

dialogue.japanese: でも、このゲームって結局何が面白いの？
dialogue.english: But what exactly is supposed to be fun about it?

dialogue.japanese: 途中から誰も何も決めなくなっちゃいましたもんね。
dialogue.english: At some point, everyone just stopped making decisions.

dialogue.japanese: 私は言われたものを描いただけですし……
dialogue.english: I only drew what I was told to draw...

dialogue.japanese: 僕も依頼通り作っただけですね。
dialogue.english: And I only made what I was asked to make.

dialogue.japanese: 誰も間違ってはいない。
dialogue.english: Nobody did anything wrong.

dialogue.japanese: 誰もゲームを作ってなかった。
dialogue.english: But nobody was actually making a game.

dialogue.japanese: ……ごめん。
dialogue.english: ...I'm sorry.

dialogue.japanese: クリアできます。
dialogue.english: It can be beaten.

dialogue.japanese: 素材も全部あります。
dialogue.english: All the assets are there.

dialogue.japanese: 音も鳴ります。
dialogue.english: The sound works.

dialogue.japanese: バグもありません。
dialogue.english: There are no bugs.

dialogue.japanese: ……なんか、面白くないね。
dialogue.english: ...But somehow, it isn't fun.

dialogue.japanese: "完成"と"面白い"は違うから。
dialogue.english: “Finished” and “fun” are not the same thing.

dialogue.japanese: そうだね……
dialogue.english: You're right...

dialogue.japanese: マップジェネレーター完成。
dialogue.english: Map generator complete.

dialogue.japanese: システムも全部作り直した。
dialogue.english: I rebuilt the entire system too.

dialogue.japanese: ステージ作る必要もうないんですか？
dialogue.english: So I don't need to make stages anymore?

dialogue.japanese: え……全部描き直しですか？
dialogue.english: What...? Do I have to redraw everything?

dialogue.japanese: 曲もステージごとに全部変えるんです？
dialogue.english: Do I have to make different music for every stage too?

dialogue.japanese: ちょ、ちょっと待って！
dialogue.english: W-Wait a second!

dialogue.japanese: ステージ自分で作っても...
dialogue.english: I can make the stages myself...

dialogue.japanese: いや、その前に設計変更する。
dialogue.english: No. First, I'm changing the design.

dialogue.japanese: えぇ...
dialogue.english: What...?

dialogue.japanese: 終わらない……
dialogue.english: We're never going to finish...

dialogue.japanese: 終わらないですねぇ……
dialogue.english: No, we're not going to finish...

dialogue.japanese: …………ごめん、時間切れ。
dialogue.english: ...Sorry. We're out of time.

dialogue.japanese: ……やりすぎたね。
dialogue.english: ...We went too far.

dialogue.japanese: どう？
dialogue.english: Well?

dialogue.japanese: 面白くないね。
dialogue.english: It's not fun.

dialogue.japanese: ……はい。
dialogue.english: ...Yeah.

dialogue.japanese: 曲だけ浮いてる気がします。
dialogue.english: The music feels completely out of place.

dialogue.japanese: 消す？
dialogue.english: Delete it?

dialogue.japanese: 消そうか。
dialogue.english: Let's delete it.

dialogue.japanese: あ。
dialogue.english: Oh.

dialogue.japanese: あれ。
dialogue.english: Wait.

dialogue.japanese: リスタートしてもすぐやられるんだけど。
dialogue.english: I die again the instant I restart.

dialogue.japanese: あー。
dialogue.english: Ah.

dialogue.japanese: 詰みだね。
dialogue.english: It's a softlock.

dialogue.japanese: 針の上でセーブされちゃいましたね……
dialogue.english: It saved right on top of the spikes...

dialogue.japanese: 永遠に死に続けるホラーゲームになりましたね。
dialogue.english: We accidentally made a horror game where you die forever.

dialogue.japanese: 想定できなかった……
dialogue.english: I didn't see that coming...

dialogue.japanese: ……これは監督者責任のわたしのせいだ
dialogue.english: ...This is my fault as the person in charge.

dialogue.japanese: まぁ、はは……
dialogue.english: Well... haha...

dialogue.japanese: もっと追加しましょう！
dialogue.english: Let's add more!

dialogue.japanese: じゃあキャラも増やします！
dialogue.english: Then I'll add more characters!

dialogue.japanese: 曲もあと三曲作ります！
dialogue.english: I'll make three more tracks!

dialogue.japanese: いいね！！
dialogue.english: Sounds great!!

dialogue.japanese: もういっそ仕様変えます！
dialogue.english: Let's just change the whole spec!

dialogue.japanese: え？
dialogue.english: Huh?

dialogue.japanese: さっき決めたのやめます！もはやこれはゲームではない！芸術だ！
dialogue.english: Forget what we just decided! This is no longer a game! It's art!

dialogue.japanese: それはさすがに……
dialogue.english: That's going a little too far...

dialogue.japanese: ありです！
dialogue.english: I'm in!

dialogue.japanese: やりましょう！
dialogue.english: Let's do it!

dialogue.japanese: え、ごっとくん……
dialogue.english: Wait, Got...?

dialogue.japanese: うん、手遅れ
dialogue.english: Yep. It's too late.

dialogue.japanese: ……完璧
dialogue.english: ...Perfect.

dialogue.japanese: バグなし！
dialogue.english: No bugs!

dialogue.japanese: 素材全部間に合いました
dialogue.english: We finished all the assets in time.

dialogue.japanese: BGMも効果音も実装確認済みです。
dialogue.english: The music and sound effects are all implemented and checked.

dialogue.japanese: 全部見てもらえて嬉しいですね。
dialogue.english: I'm glad they got to see everything.

dialogue.japanese: このゲーム、ちゃんと最後まで面白かった。
dialogue.english: This game was genuinely fun from beginning to end.

dialogue.japanese: みんな、本当にありがとう。
dialogue.english: Thank you so much, everyone.

dialogue.japanese: 楽しかったです！
dialogue.english: I had a great time!

dialogue.japanese: ゲームジャムってこんなに面白いんですね。

dialogue.japanese: ……まぁ。

dialogue.japanese: 次はもっと面白いもの作ろう。

dialogue.japanese: ありがとう。
dialogue.english: Thank you.

dialogue.japanese: 君は知っているかもしれないけど、
dialogue.english: You may already know this, but...

dialogue.japanese: 開発には正解なんてない。
dialogue.english: There is no single right answer in game development.

dialogue.japanese: 誰が悪いわけでもない。
dialogue.english: No one person is to blame.

dialogue.japanese: 指示に最適解もない。
dialogue.english: There is no perfect way to give directions.

dialogue.english: When it comes to implementation...

dialogue.japanese: 世界観の

dialogue.japanese: 答えはひとつじゃない。
dialogue.english: ...there is more than one answer.

dialogue.japanese: それに
dialogue.english: And...

dialogue.japanese: 正しさを持つのは、
dialogue.english: the right answer...

dialogue.japanese: 君だけじゃない。
dialogue.english: doesn't belong to you alone.

dialogue.japanese: これ以上は語らなくてもいいかな。
dialogue.english: I think that's all I need to say.

dialogue.japanese: ここまで遊んでくれた君なら、
dialogue.english: If you've played this far...

dialogue.japanese: きっと良い企画開発者になれる。
dialogue.english: I'm sure you'll become a great game planner.

dialogue.japanese: 最後に、
dialogue.english: And finally...

dialogue.japanese: ここまで遊んでくれてありがとう。
